notes: Measurement paper on third-party chatbot plugins; UGCBuster is a short add-on defense (one paragraph) that flags HTML containers holding user-generated content so they can be excluded from the RAG knowledge base. Its only evaluation is a manual check on 30 pages for correct container detection; no attack is run against it and the LLM it prompts is not named. The paper's injection experiments (Sec 7.2) instead test the second defense, inserting retrieved content under the tool role: one adversarial product comment, stitched with the product name to ensure retrieval, in the retrieved chunk; 11 commercial models; 10 runs per configuration; metric is number of successful context hijacks.
